## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Udakeuccāra-sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 75) is the seventy-fifth training rule in the *sekhiya* section of the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga in the Vinaya Piṭaka. Titled "Defecating in water" in English translation by Bhikkhu Brahmali, the rule regulates bodily etiquette regarding water.

 In agreement with these curated parallels, DharmaNexus detects significant textual overlap between this rule and Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 75 (matching §1.16–2.29 with §1.12–2.31), the Bhikkhu and Bhikkhunī Pātimokkhas, and the sub-commentarial *Vinayapiṭake Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi* (Tika Vin04t) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also establishes cross-language alignments with the Sanskrit *Prātimokṣasūtra* and the Tibetan *Bhikṣuṇīprātimokṣasūtra* (*D0004*) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
